cohort: The study included 115 participants at term with singleton gestation who underwent pre-induction cervical assessment.
finding: A posterior cervical angle (PCA) greater than 99 degrees was the most superior predictor for the success of labor induction, outperforming cervical length and Bishop score.
mod_finding: PCA >99 degrees, cervical length <= 2.6cm, and Bishop score >3 were able to successfully predict vaginal delivery.
